article.title: Delta reps move to APC
article.text: Hon. Oghenekaro Edewor-Tobi and Hon. Efe Ovie-Akpobire, members of the House of Representatives from Delta State, have joined the All Progressives Congress. Edewor-Tobi left the Peoples Democratic Party and Ovie-Akpobire left the Labour Party; both were received at a rally in Asaba on Saturday.
